package.name: code-janitor
package.description: Professional code formatter and AI-powered syntax fixer for C, C++, Arduino, Java, JavaScript, Python, and HTML. Features Alt+D instant syntax fix with NVIDIA/Ollama/Groq AI, live preview, intelligent code analysis, and Graphify project visualization.

scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:java && npm run format:py && npm run format:c && npm run format:html
